test.name: Fuzz the four provider targets for 10 minutes each on this Mac

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runs provider_manifest, provider_template, provider_interpolation, and provider_settings_schema for 600 seconds each with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory in any target and fuzz/artifacts/ empty; provider_manifest: 615381 runs in 601 s (1023 exec/s), cov 13390, ft 33496, corpus 1882 inputs, peak RSS 397 MB; provider_template: 111976 runs in 601 s (186 exec/s), cov 12947, ft 34395, corpus 1407 inputs, peak RSS 423 MB; provider_interpolation: 1197806 runs in 601 s (1993 exec/s), cov 1394, ft 4759, corpus 748 inputs, peak RSS 602 MB; provider_settings_schema: 3228942 runs in 601 s (5372 exec/s), cov 8572, ft 26062, corpus 1801 inputs, peak RSS 497 MB
steps: on commit 863022a with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2 that feature 6 installed on this Mac; `cargo xtask fuzz build` builds the four provider targets with AddressSanitizer (default)

the committed seeds come from providers/fake, providers/nats, providers/traefik, and the core fixture fake-command (`cargo xtask fuzz seed`): provider_manifest 4, provider_template 6, provider_interpolation 31, provider_settings_schema 4; a 20 second smoke run of each came first, so fuzz/corpus/<target> already held its inputs

run `cargo xtask fuzz run <target> --time 600` for provider_manifest, provider_template, provider_interpolation, and provider_settings_schema side by side; xtask checks both pins and fuzz/Cargo.lock, then runs libFuzzer with -max_len 262144, 262144, 4096, and 131072 and -max_total_time=600 on fuzz/corpus/<target> plus fuzz/seeds/<target>; the runs went from 2026-10-18T09:51:48Z to 10:01:52Z
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input for any target, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the head and tail of each log in this record's files folder (the middle NEW, REDUCE, and pulse progress lines are cut)
